**[P2] Keep pause deferral on the execution lane**

This load/save runs outside the per-execution worker lane and can race with checkpoints, timer/callback completions, or `resume_execution()`. Disk-backed stores can overwrite newer execution state, while a resume race can leave a deferred invocation unscheduled. It also discards `delay`, bypassing retry backoff. Always schedule the handler and let the serialized pause guard in `_begin_invocation()` record the deferral when the invocation becomes due.
